description: Sri Lanka Customs - Customs Notifications No. 2/2021 Bonded Ware house
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (No. 2/2021) made by the Director General of Customs under the authority of Section 69 of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes and regulates bonded warehouses, which is a regulatory matter concerning customs procedures, import duties, and the storage of goods. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a government official is named, the content's primary purpose is regulatory, not about the personnel change or their detailed portfolio responsibilities.
